output.meaning: predicted mobile data used in the next 60 minutes, in MB (1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes, same as UsageRecord.mb_used)
output.pet_derivation: PET = now + remaining_quota_mb / max(predicted_mb_per_hour, 0.01) hours; recompute every hour

hour_window: local clock hour [HH:00, HH+1:00) using utc_offset_minutes; features describe the hour that just ended
mobile_usage_rule: mobile MB = sum of per-tick usage where network_type is not WIFI or NONE; WIFI/NONE ticks count as 0, not missing

features.name: hour_sin
features.formula: sin(2*pi*hour/24), hour 0-23 of the hour just ended

features.name: mobile_mb_last_1h
features.formula: mobile MB in the hour just ended

features.name: mobile_mb_avg_last_3h
features.formula: mean hourly mobile MB over the last 3 hours (hours with data only)

features.name: mobile_mb_avg_last_24h
features.formula: mean hourly mobile MB over the last 24 hours (hours with data only)

features.name: wifi_share_last_1h
features.formula: fraction 0-1 of the last hour on Wi-Fi

features.name: signal_dbm_last_1h
features.formula: mean cellular signal dBm in the last hour; -100.0 if none valid (-999 excluded)

features.name: screen_on_share_last_1h
features.formula: fraction 0-1 of the last hour with the screen on
